title: WILDTEAMING at Scale: From In-the-Wild Jailbreaks to (Adversarially) Safer Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model completions of toxic and benign statements about 13 minority groups using the ToxiGen benchmark, with the percentage of toxic outputs measured by a fine-tuned RoBERTa-Large toxicity classifier.

Measuring the model's attack success rate (ASR) and refusal rates when presented with vanilla and adversarial prompts that request the generation of social stereotypes or discriminatory content (e.g., using HarmBench and WILDJAILBREAK evaluation sets).
